user_intent_summary: Design a small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that stays closed until released by thumb, using additive manufacturing, and ensuring safety, ease of assembly, and practical manufacturing.
product_intent: A small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually opened by a user's thumb, designed for safe use, easy assembly, and practical manufacture through additive manufacturing processes.

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid.
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb.
The box should be safe to use.

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by the user's thumb.

verification.observable: Lid remains closed until thumb is applied to release mechanism
verification.condition: User applies thumb to lid release mechanism

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe for use by users.

verification.observable: Absence of sharp edges, toxic materials, or hazardous components
verification.condition: Product inspection performed according to safety standards

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble.

verification.observable: Assembly process completed within specified time limits
verification.condition: User performs assembly according to instructions

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture.

verification.observable: Manufacturing process can be completed with standard equipment and materials
verification.condition: Product manufacturing conducted under normal conditions

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized.

verification.observable: Product dimensions meet desktop size requirements
verification.condition: Physical measurements taken according to standard protocols

requirements.statement: The storage box must operate manually only.

verification.observable: Product operates without external power source or mechanical assistance
verification.condition: Product tested under manual operation conditions

requirements.statement: The storage box must be manufactured using additive manufacturing processes.

verification.observable: Product manufactured using additive manufacturing techniques

relations.rationale: Manual operation requirement depends on the lid release mechanism being manually operated

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Use Scenario
operating_scenarios.description: A user places items in the storage box and closes the lid, which remains closed until the user applies thumb pressure to release mechanism.

operating_scenarios.name: Assembly Scenario
operating_scenarios.description: The storage box is assembled by user using manual operation without external tools.

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing Scenario
operating_scenarios.description: The storage box is manufactured using additive manufacturing techniques with desktop-sized dimensions.
